lines.text: Many learners say: I am Anna. Please take care of me.
Better: I am Anna. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you! Hello, I am Anna. Nice to meet you.

data.wrong: I am Anna. Please take care of me.
data.right: I am Anna. Nice to meet you.

en.tip: When we meet someone new, we say nice to meet you. Say “I am Anna. Nice to meet you.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I am Anna. Please take care of me.” When we meet someone new, we say nice to meet you. Right: “I am Anna. Nice to meet you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
